Each character's mood comes from what has happened to them, several things at once: a battle won or lost, a tournament, being a prisoner or wounded, a dead relative or friend, a war just declared, a birth. Each one lasts a few days. Off: only how the last talk left them counts.
100 = normal: a tournament win is savoured for 5 days, a battle for 3 or 4, mourning lasts 14 days for family and 10 for a friend. 200 = twice as long.

Women aged 13 to 47 have a cycle: it changes their mood depending on the day (a lot for some, hardly at all for others) and the chance of pregnancy, the game's own included. No cycle during pregnancy or after giving birth. She knows what day she is on.
Campaign days. A game year has 84 days, so 21 means four cycles a year.
